# Index of checklist cards

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_prompts.py from plugin/skills/open-paper-reviewer. Do not edit by hand. -->

202 cards in 13 folders. Phase 1 uses every core card, plus every other card whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. To find those:

1. Read the list of folders below, with the names of the cards in each.
2. Read the index of every folder with a card whose name could apply to the paper: its field, a technique in its methods, or a kind of claim it makes. A paper often draws on more than one folder.
3. In each folder index, select the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper, and open only those.

Paths are relative to this folder. The card format is in `README.md`.

## Core cards: always used

| Id | Card | File |

| C-AVAILABILITY | Availability of data, code and supplementary material | [core/availability.md](core/availability.md) |
| C-UNCERTAINTY | Calibration and uncertainty | [core/uncertainty.md](core/uncertainty.md) |
| C-CONTROLS | Controls and nulls | [core/controls.md](core/controls.md) |
| C-PROCESSING | Data processing | [core/processing.md](core/processing.md) |
| C-EVIDENCE | Evidence in proportion to the claim | [core/evidence.md](core/evidence.md) |
| C-CONSISTENCY | Internal consistency | [core/consistency.md](core/consistency.md) |
| C-STATISTICS | Statistics and sample size | [core/statistics.md](core/statistics.md) |
| C-CITATIONS | Use of citations | [core/citations.md](core/citations.md) |
